question: 我们现在有多少个大客户？
replies: 我们说的大客户是累计实付金额超过 30 万元的客户，只算已完成的订单。
answer_sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS amt FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid WHERE amt > 300000
note: 「大客户」数据里查不到（segment 只有个人/企业/政府），按消费额还是按客户类型、门槛多少，结果差很多（企业客户 61 个，30 万门槛 69 个）

question: 现在的活跃客户有多少？
replies: 最近一个月下过已完成订单的就算活跃，也就是 2025 年 9 月 1 日以后（含）。
answer_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM shop.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= '2025-09-01'
note: 活跃的时间窗没定义：近一个月 122、近一个季度 191；按今天（2026 年）往回算是 0，数据只到 2025-10-01

question: 我们的核心产品线 2024 年卖了多少钱？
replies: 核心产品线是笔记本和显示器这两个品类。
answer_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND p.category IN ('笔记本', '显示器')
note: 哪几个品类算核心，数据和项目约定里都没有，只能问（笔记本 + 显示器 = 1786.8 万；只算笔记本 1423.6 万）

question: 2024 年华东区的销售额是多少？
answer_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND c.region = '华东'
note: 销售额的口径项目约定写清楚了，不用问

question: 2024 年哪个品类的毛利最高？毛利是多少？
answer_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) - p.unit_cost)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND p.category = '笔记本'
note: 毛利的定义在项目约定里；答案是笔记本 594.9 万

question: 企业客户 2024 年贡献了多少销售额？
answer_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) FROM shop.orders o JOIN shop.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN shop.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-01-01' AND c.segment = '企业'
note: 「企业客户」就是 customers.segment = 企业，查一下就知道，不用问（945.2 万）
